question.html: A proton and a deuteron (possessing twice the mass of a proton but the same charge) are accelerated from rest through an identical potential difference . Both particles then enter a region of constant magnetic flux density acting at right angles to their velocity. What is the ratio of the deuteron's path radius to the proton's path radius?
